PCATS.sub: Thank you, you're welcome, excuse me and more
items: Say it after any help or favor.
A slightly more polite way to say you're welcome.
Also a warm way to answer gracias.
Use it for small things, like bumping into someone.
For something that matters, or for sad news.
Excuse me, can you help me?
Disculpe is the polite way to get someone's attention.
Excuse me (to pass or to enter)
The answer to mucho gusto, buen provecho and good wishes.

PCATS.sub: Me too, of course, oh well, seriously?
items: Use it to agree with something someone says about themselves.
The negative version: No me gusta el frío. Yo tampoco.
What you say when someone apologizes.
Oh well, nothing to be done

PCATS.sub: Who you are, where you live, what you do
items: What do you do for work?
Spanish says I have years, not I am years.
What do you like to do?
I like going to the gym

Do you have a bigger size?
How do I get to the hospital?
What are you going to do today?
Do you want to come with me?
I'll be there in ten minutes
